stem:
John was given the following table by his teacher and was asked to identify the graph that correctly displays the data. Which graph below should he choose?

| Name | Savings |
| :--- | :--- |
| Sara | 22 zeds |
| Peter | 15 zeds |
| Pamela | 17 zeds |
| Chris | 10 zeds |

options.label: A
options.text: [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled Savings (in zeds), values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 4 columns, Sara value of 22, Peter value of 15, Pamela value of 17, Chris value of 10.]

options.label: B
options.text: [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled Savings (in zeds), values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 4 columns, Sara value of 22, Peter value of 17, Pamela value of 15, Chris value of 10.]

options.text: [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled Savings (in zeds), values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 4 columns, Sara value of 22, Peter value of 10, Pamela value of 15, Chris value of 17.]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image: Bar graph with y-axis labeled Savings (in zeds), values from 0 to 25; x-axis with 4 columns, Sara value of 17, Peter value of 15, Pamela value of 22, Chris value of 10.]

figure_description:
Four bar graphs labeled A, B, C, and D. Each graph has a vertical axis labeled "Savings (in zeds)" marked from 0 to 25 in increments of 5 with horizontal grid lines, and a horizontal axis with four labeled bars: Sara, Peter, Pamela, and Chris.
- In Graph A: Sara's bar height is about 22, Peter's bar height is 15, Pamela's bar height is about 17, and Chris's bar height is 10.
- In Graph B: Sara's bar height is about 22, Peter's bar height is about 17, Pamela's bar height is 15, and Chris's bar height is 10.
- In Graph C: Sara's bar height is about 22, Peter's bar height is 10, Pamela's bar height is 15, and Chris's bar height is about 17.
- In Graph D: Sara's bar height is about 17, Peter's bar height is 15, Pamela's bar height is about 22, and Chris's bar height is 10.
